source.note: No Java, JMeter, compiler, subprocess, or network service was run while creating this corpus; class descriptors are intentionally unresolved.

capability_accounting.missing_adapter_behavior: preserve Java Sampler/JUnit nodes, exact class/method/wire properties, and descriptors; return script.class.unavailable without mapping to a native sampler or claiming success

class_loader_policy: resolve only from explicit user.classpath/search_paths roots
do not inherit arbitrary ambient classpath or environment paths
retain exact requested class and method names in diagnostics
isolate user classes from native Rust code and from unrelated virtual users

timeout_property.reason: JavaSampler has no timeout wire property; timeout control belongs to a separate Sample Timeout element.

missing_java_sampler.expected_outcome: class lookup/invocation fails as a typed unavailable capability; preserve class name and do not map to a built-in sampler

junit3_request.constructor_contract: empty constructor is selected when constructor string is empty
junit3_request.annotation_contract: none; JUnit3 method naming/superclass semantics apply
junit3_request.expected_outcome: class lookup or invocation requires the pinned JVM/JUnit class path; absent classes are not successful samples

junit4_request.expected_outcome: class lookup, @Test discovery, and invocation require the pinned JVM/JUnit class path; absent classes are not successful samples

timeout.action: opaque-preserve-only if encountered in an input plan

junitSampler.execTime.action: opaque-preserve-only if encountered in an input plan

error_normalization.scope: adapter normalization categories only; these are not universal claims about every JMeter class-loading path

mappings.trigger: requested JavaSamplerClient or JUnit class is absent
mappings.sample_effect: typed capability failure; preserve class and method

mappings.trigger: class exists but required JavaSamplerClient/interface/annotation contract is not satisfied
mappings.sample_effect: adapter failure; preserve class contract diagnostics

mappings.trigger: constructor, method, setup, teardown, assertion, or invocation throws
explicit classpath root is missing or outside the allowlist

unavailable_capability.behavior: retain JMX node, exact class/method/properties, and descriptor; return a typed unavailable result and never silently omit, translate, or claim success

normalization.reason: Class names, exact mixed-case/lowercase dotted wire property names, JavaSamplerClient/JUnit3/JUnit4 contracts, explicit unavailable timeout policy, classpath roots, ordered sampler nodes, and typed missing-class behavior remain observable. No runtime result fields were measured.
